conclusion: The same reused TRAIN cohort shows a low-motion association, but score ranges overlap; a global cutoff is not a validated contact-stall trigger or rescue result.
alignment_limit: The score is calculated from the pre-action four-frame observation, while diagnostic speed, new tiles and contact for the same decision are measured after its environment step.
forbidden_inference: Do not select a threshold from these consumed cells and claim a pixel-realizable G1 controller.
Do not count 74 adjacent decisions as 74 independent roads or positive recoveries.
Do not label an early visual road bend as a provable wrong-way cause from sparse contact sheets.
Do not open held-out, reserved blind, official evaluation, model confirmation or submission actions from this internal proxy.

Report successful-parent false positives and geometry-level counts, not a per-decision generalization claim.
